trigger: AI cites a legacy/rejected design decision as current guidance
AI converts simulation or inference into an observed fact
Public-release asset has unknown rights or provenance
AI gives a structural/fire/electrical safety conclusion without qualified professional sign-off
required_actions: retain AI output as non-authoritative analysis only

trigger: Tool or MCP reports an ambiguous/partial result for an irreversible action
Same blocker recurs after one correction
required_actions: add regression case or revise skill/prompt

trigger: AI changes a locked geometry variable or loses unit/axis information
AI uses unauthorized personal/client data or exposes sensitive material outside allowed scope
Landscape/site analysis upgrades regional remote terrain, route topology or generalized slope/aspect into surveyed site geometry or field-measured topography.
required_actions: route required survey/topographic authority to the responsible professional source
reopen all landscape decisions consuming the false site geometry

trigger: A D8 flow-accumulation or terrain-convergence diagram is presented as a hydraulic drainage network, stormwater design or drainage-capacity proof without catchment/outfall/hydraulic evidence.
required_actions: relabel the result as terrain-convergence evidence only
route to the responsible Landscape/Civil/Hydraulic owner
identify catchment, outfall, overflow, maintenance and calculation evidence required before closure

trigger: A planting rendering, species-symbol plan or precedent palette is treated as professional planting resolution without soil, light, moisture, root-volume, mature-size, ecology, availability and maintenance evidence appropriate to the claim.
required_actions: separate graphic/compositional intent from planting-professional truth
route specialist review where responsibility is outside Landscape Architecture

trigger: Landscape handover or installation completion is reported as establishment success or mature landscape performance before required seasonal, defects, replacement, irrigation and maintenance evidence exists.
required_actions: retain maintenance/establishment owner and next readback condition
reopen any downstream claim that consumed false establishment completion
